protocol.unit: one episode (task, initial state); one trained policy seed
protocol.score: 1 - mean ordered_confidence of the first query, all 8 x 7 components; gripper uses choice_confidence
protocol.primary: within-task pair-weighted AUROC (failure positive, higher uncertainty positive)
protocol.interval: 2000 bootstrap resamples of episodes within each fixed task; percentile 95%; not across training seeds or new tasks
protocol.permutation: 2000 label permutations within task, one-sided primary AUROC >= observed, plus-one p-value
protocol.single_class: AUROC is null where either outcome is absent; report eligible task/pair counts
protocol.exclusions: transport/preflight/smoke excluded; no episodes excluded based on outcome
protocol.selection: Latest complete4500 checkpoint, task0, init0–1; sample count fixed by predeclared second, warmed preflight latency rule before scored rollout. One-off development pilot; fixed100k final release policy unchanged.
protocol.calibration: none; confidence is not a task success probability; do not compute success-probability ECE/Brier
limits: Known Spatial tasks; development diagnostic, not a new-task test
Conditional on one sampled denoising path; not epistemic uncertainty
One checkpoint and training seed; association does not establish causal explanation or safer control
protocol.interpretation_scope: Small single-task pilot during ongoing B64 training; CPU-streamed BF16 weights with CUDA arithmetic; timing is contended and not a standalone inference benchmark.
